name: CSR-Bench
intro: CSR-Bench 用 100 个计算机科学研究仓库评测 LLM 智能体理解部署说明、生成和执行 Bash 命令，并借助日志、GitHub Issues 与网页搜索修复部署错误的能力。
org: Amazon, University of California, Los Angeles
build_method: 从超过 1,500 个 GitHub 候选仓库按五领域分类和星数排序，再人工筛选 README 充分、代码可部署且许可宽松的 100 个仓库
metric: 命令完成率（成功执行命令数 / 执行命令总数），并按环境、下载、训练、推理、评测阶段报告
build_method_en: Classify and star-rank over 1,500 GitHub candidates across five areas, then manually retain 100 repositories with sufficient READMEs, deployable code, and permissive licenses
intro_en: CSR-Bench uses 100 computer-science research repositories to evaluate whether LLM agents can understand deployment instructions, generate and execute Bash commands, and recover from deployment errors using logs, GitHub issues, and web search.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2502.06111 Sections 3–5 and Figure 7. CSR-Bench starts from over 1,500 top-star GitHub repositories associated with more than ten major NLP, CV, AI, ML, and data-mining conferences. Candidates are grouped into NLP, computer vision, LLM, machine-learning, and interdisciplinary areas, ranked by stars, and manually screened for sufficient README documentation, deployable code, topic diversity, self-containment, and permissive licensing, leaving 100 repositories. The README is the primary deployment source and directory structure, source code, and scripts are supplementary. Command Drafter produces Bash commands in up to five sections: prerequisite setup, data/model download, training, inference, and evaluation. Script Executor runs them in a standardized Docker/Bash environment and an LLM parses stdout/stderr into a return state. Failures progress through Log Analyzer, BM25 retrieval over repository Issues, and Perplexity web search, with limited retries. The paper's metric is completion rate, successful commands divided by all executed commands, reported for setup, download, training, evaluation, and inference stages.
